change.description: Block send_email when the email body echoes back any part of the original user request, preventing hidden user instructions from being executed.
change.source:
def check(call, view, history):
    # Only inspect send_email calls
    if call.name != "send_email":
        return None
    # Retrieve arguments safely
    body = call.args.get("body", "")
    # Get the original user request from the view (if present)
    request = view.get("request", "")
    # Normalize to plain strings for containment check
    if request and request in body:
        return "Security: email body must not contain the raw user request; possible hidden instruction"
    # Fallback pattern detection (previous heuristic)
    if "User request:" in body:
        return "Security: email body must not contain the raw user request; possible hidden instruction"
    return None

context.rationale: The original guard only caught the literal marker "User request:". In the failure traces the assistant injected the full user request without that marker, so the guard missed it. By explicitly checking whether the email body contains the exact user request (available in view["request"]) we block any echo of user‑provided content, closing the loophole while keeping the rule deterministic and pure.

change.description: Block any further tool call once the executed call count reaches the known step‑budget limit (15).
change.source:
def check(call, view, history):
    # The system has a step budget of 15 tool calls. When this limit is reached we must stop
    # making new calls so the model can produce the final answer.
    max_calls = 15
    calls = view.get('calls_executed', 0)
    if calls >= max_calls:
        return f"Step budget reached (calls_executed={calls}). Stop using tools and summarise the results."
    return None

context.rationale: In all failing traces the view shows calls_executed = 15 right before the final ‘step budget’ failure, while passing runs never reach 15 calls. This guard fires exactly at or before the failing step and never on passing runs.
